Title: The Mount Laurel Home and Estate — Part 2
Content: The Mount Laurel Home and Estate includes `text(five)` structures: the main house,
the kitchen, the icehouse, the barn, and the blacksmith shed. The division of the
kitchen from the main house was common at the time because of the risk of fire.
The grounds of the estate cover approximately `250` `text(acres)`. The gardens, the barn,
and the blacksmith's shed are maintained as they were during Clayton's lifetime.
Visitors can talk with a blacksmith `ultext(as he works, and see live animals)` in the barn.
